body_markdown:
PITTSBURGH


, Oct. 30, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Matthews International Corporation](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806374-1&h=1272198940&u=http%3A%2F%2Fmatw.com%2F&a=Matthews%C2%A0International+Corporation) ( NASDAQ GSM: MATW


) today announced plans to release its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 earnings results after the market closes on Thursday, November 19, 2026


The Company will host a conference call and webcast to review the financial and operating results for the period and discuss its outlook. Participating in the call will be Mike Whitehead, President and CEO and Daniel E. Stopar, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer. A question-and-answer session will follow.


Fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 *Conference Call*


Friday, November 20, 2026
9:00 a.m. Eastern Time
Phone: 203-518-9757
Conference ID: Matthews
Webcast and accompanying slide presentation:[Webcast](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806374-1&h=1116629859&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.matw.com%2Finvestors%2Ffinancial-information&a=Webcast)
Register and add to your calendar:[Register](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806374-1&h=1879255166&u=https%3A%2F%2Fviavid.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1780058%26tp_key%3D483ccadb0e&a=Register)


As soon as available after the call, a transcript of the call will be posted in the Investor Relations section of the Company's website:[Investor Relations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806374-1&h=3177518646&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.matw.com%2Finvestors%2Ffinancial-information&a=Investor+Relations) .


**About Matthews International Corporation** Matthews International Corporation operates through two core global businesses – Industrial Technologies and Memorialization. Both are focused on driving operational efficiency and long-term growth through continuous innovation and strategic expansion. The Industrial Technologies segment evolved from our original marking business, which today is a leading global innovator committed to empowering visionaries to transform industries through the application of precision technologies and intelligent processes. The Memorialization segment is a leading provider of memorialization products, including memorials, caskets, and cremation and incineration equipment, primarily to cemetery and funeral home customers that help families move from grief to remembrance. In addition, the Company also has a significant investment in Propelis, a brand solutions business formed through the merger of SGK and SGS & Co. Propelis delivers integrated solutions including brand creative, packaging, print solutions, branded environments, and content production. Matthews International has over 4,300 employees in 15 countries on four continents that are committed to delivering the highest quality products and services.
